# Third-party notices

This package uses `fzstd` for ZIP method 93 (Zstandard) entries. `fzstd` is
Copyright (c) 2021 Arjun Barrett and is distributed under the MIT License.

All stored and Deflate ZIP entries are decoded with browser APIs and do not use
an additional compression library.

This package uses `earcut` for bounded triangulation of validated face polygons
and contained holes. `earcut` is Copyright (c) 2016 Mapbox and is distributed
under the ISC License.
